subject: Dedicated capacity uplift: proposal and throughput SLA details
messages:
From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@ariaanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha N'Goma <aisha@ariaanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: mid-contract GPU pool upsize and pricing

Marcus —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're seeing a ~45% QoQ increase in token volume for our chat assistants and the existing dedicated GPU pool is hitting our throughput ceiling during peak windows. We have the committed pool through March 2027 and are evaluating two paths: a mid-contract uplift to add 8 GPUs now, or structuring a step-up commit that phases additional capacity through Q1.

Attached is a CSV of last quarter's utilization and a draft internal ask (Aria_commit_request_v2.xlsx). Our main asks:
- A clear per-GPU unit price for an immediate uplift (8x A100-equivalent) and the discount tiers if we commit to a stepped increase through Q1.
- Throughput SLOs you can commit to per-pool size (95th percentile tail latency under a realistic request mix).
- Any pro-rated credit/offset you can provide for increasing commits mid-term.

We're on a tight renewal cadence for budget approval the week of Sep 27. Can you get back with a proposal and a short SLA draft that we can include in the finance packet?

Thanks —
Tom
VP Product, Aria Analytics

Attachments: Aria_Monthly_usage_Q2.csv, Aria_commit_request_v2.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@ariaanalytics.com>
Cc: Aisha N'Goma <aisha@ariaanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: mid-contract GPU pool upsize and pricing

Tom —

Appreciate the data, that makes the ask concrete. High level response and next steps below:

1) Two commercial paths (summary)
   - Immediate uplift: add 8 GPUs to your existing pool (effective immediately). We can offer a 15% uplift discount off list for the additional GPUs for the remainder of your term (prorated), with a 9-12% blended ARR discount if you convert to a stepped commit through Q1.
   - Phased step-up: commit to +4 GPUs now and +4 GPUs at contract anniversary (or set milestones). That gets you a 12% initial uplift discount and a guarantee on capacity availability on milestone dates.

2) Throughput SLOs
   - For a pool of current size +8 GPUs we can commit to 95th percentile gen latency < 280ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens) under your observed traffic shape, and < 400ms for heavy batched requests (90th percentile). We'll capture detailed traffic during a short 48-72 hour probe run to confirm.

3) Credits / pro-ration
   - We can pro-rate the committed discount for the remainder of the term and apply a one-time execution credit equal to 20% of the uplifted capacity for the first billing month to offset migration/testing.

I'll draft a formal quote and a short SLA (PDF) and loop in pricing/ops for the detailed throughput verification. Would Fri Sep 18 EOD for a formal quote work for your budget packet?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA-Draft-Aria-2026.pdf (draft)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Inquiry: mid-contract GPU pool upsize and pricing — pricing approval needed

Kimberly / Chloe / Aditya —

Forwarding Aria's ask and my proposed commercial paths. Key points: 8-GPU immediate uplift request; Tom asked for a per-GPU price and clear SLO language for the finance packet. I proposed a 15% uplift discount for immediate add (prorated) or a phased step-up with blended discount. Also suggested a one-time execution credit (20% of uplifted capacity for month 1).

Questions for pricing/ops:
- Can we support the latency commitments above for Aria's traffic profile? If ops wants a narrower SLO we should adjust the pricing.
- Is 15% uplift discount on additional GPUs reasonable for sales to sign? If not, what's the max concession we can make without Partner/finance sign-off?

Tom's deadline for a packet is Fri 18th. Can we aim to finalize numbers by Thu EOD so I can prepare quote and SLA?

Thanks —
Marcus

-- Forwarded message attached --

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Inquiry: mid-contract GPU pool upsize and pricing — pricing approval needed

Team —

Thanks for the summary, Marcus. I ran the uplift through the deal desk quickly with product ops. Notes:
- Pricing: we can stretch to 18% uplift discount on the incremental 8 GPUs, but only if Aria signs a stepped commit to formalize the additional capacity through their anniversary (minimum 9-month obligation). Otherwise, cap at 15%.
- Credits: the one-time 20% execution credit approved, but it should be applied as invoice credit (not gross discount) and limited to onboarding-related usage only.
- SLA language: Ops will agree to the latency buckets you proposed but requests a short 72-hr probe (non-production keys) as a verification step before hard SLA dates are guaranteed.

Marcus — please use 18% (conditional on stepped commit) as the concession in the quote and include the verification probe language in the SLA draft. If Aria pushes for pure immediate 8-GPU add with no step-up, keep to 15% and escalate if they push beyond that.

Kimberly
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@ariaanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha N'Goma <aisha@ariaanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity uplift: proposal and throughput SLA details

Marcus —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity. Two quick follow-ups from our CFO and infra lead after reviewing the packet:
1) The CFO prefers the phased step-up with the capped 18% uplift (conditional on the milestone commit) rather than an immediate 8-GPU add with a smaller discount. That fits our budget cadence.
2) Infra wants the 72-hour probe window and would like the probe to include a small synthetic tail test (we've attached a suggested script in Aria_commit_request_v2.xlsx).

If you can send a finalized quote reflecting the phased step-up, milestone dates, and the invoice credit mechanics, we'll get the packet in front of procurement next week. Can we also include a short annex in the SLA that defines the probe methodology and acceptance criteria?

Thanks —
Tom
VP Product, Aria Analytics

Attachments referenced: Aria_commit_request_v2.xlsx
